description: Fast pre-payment sanity check for agents on Base: confirms the RPC reports Base mainnet (chain ID 8453) and that the official USDC contract has deployed code. No request body. Returns PASS or FAIL with both checks and a timestamp. It is not a token-risk report, transaction simulation or payment proof. Paid tool: 0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.
name: quick_check
title: Quick Check
